comment: ANCHOR: RELEASE_TRAIN_MERGE_FREEZE_20261025 — Release Train v2 merge freeze enforced (AGENTS.md section 25.3;
docs/ops/RELEASE_TRAIN_MERGE_FREEZE.md): scripts/lib/release_train_freeze.py computes it from the policy
schedule (DST-safe, weekday 12/18, weekend every 3 h) plus the train's receipts and live train states;
unreadable receipts freeze the 30-min pre-window only; STOP lifts all but a running train. Enforced by the
train-merge-freeze commit status (.github/workflows/train-merge-freeze.yml; exempt: the train/<id> batch PR,
label freeze-exempt), scripts/agent_merge_pr.sh (check-pr exit 3) and the Tier 2 merge (MERGE_FREEZE); the
readers of main's required checks drop the context; Releases & schedules shows it. Hermetic: tmp state, fake gh.
